notice: Typical/datasheet currents plus explicitly identified assumptions. Replace assumptions with measured board values before claiming runtime.

mcu_stop.basis: STM32L031 STOP current 0.35 uA (datasheet typical, operating conditions matter)

mcu_run.basis: 76 uA/MHz x configured 4 MHz; application-dependent peripheral/clock load omitted

imu_low_power.basis: Configured estimate 0.8 uA; LIS2DW12 product summary states active low-power below 1 uA

radio_sleep.basis: Board-level sleep allowance, including radio/module leakage; not asserted as a validated SX1262 value

radio_tx.basis: Firmware default is +10 dBm; no +10 dBm current is sourced here. Uses 45 mA as a conservative proxy referenced to the Semtech +14 dBm value; this is not a +10 dBm datasheet claim and must be measured/replaced.

radio_rx.basis: SX1262 active receive current from Semtech product information

ngspice_pulse_model.note: Illustrative idealized cell plus series resistance and reservoir capacitor; not a selected battery datasheet model.
